name: careerweaver
description: Tailor resumes from a verified fact graph and fill job applications (Greenhouse/Lever/Workable/Ashby), stopping before submit for human review.

interface.shortDescription: Resume tailoring and job application filling, human-approved
interface.longDescription: Builds resumes only from facts you imported, fills ATS applications in your own browser, and stops at audit_pending. There is no submit tool.
defaultPrompt: Tailor my resume for this job posting.
Fill this application and stop before submitting.
